How to pick a room.

Follow the child, not the timetable: a child who paints everything at home will walk into the Art Studio on their own, while the one who lines up toys by size is ready for the Maths Room's patterns. Every room here runs on everyday materials — paper, crayons, a tub of water, a handful of leaves — so you can decide in the morning and start by lunch. Each activity lists its ages on the card, includes ways to make it simpler or stretch it further, and finishes with something printable: a diary, a map or a results sheet your child fills in. If you are not sure where to begin, the sound map and the shape collage are the two easiest wins for mixed ages, and the paper bridge is the one older children come back to.
